KBC Monday Night Ride

Kalamazoo, MI · Road

Beginner friendly

KBC Monday Night Ride is a road group ride in Kalamazoo, MI. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Texas Drive Park. About 15–30 miles, up to eight groups, 12–13 mph through 19–21 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KBC Monday Night Ride group ride

The club's main weeknight ride, with up to eight pace groups from a 12–13 mph no-drop learner ride to a fast Lawton loop. Pick your group in the parking lot. Helmets required.
